author: Claude (claude.ai), 2 Nov 2026, after the w4/w16 results (RESULT_BIN_HINGE_2026_11_02.md)
optimizer_state: fresh Adam (the parent checkpoint stores no optimizer state)
rationale: Attribution control for w4: identical recipe, seed and schedule, bin weight 0. w4 passed every original development gate (old24 0 EV .0537, +3 EV .00241) but its hinge diagnostic rose during training, so its gains may come from 1600 more steps of the 25 Oct recipe rather than the hinge. Registered AFTER seeing w4: it attributes, it does not select. If w0 matches w4 on the development gates, the gains are the recipe's; if not, the hinge's.
gates: original limits, unchanged: every paired gate of claude_d6400_neg_y_guard_eval_20261025 including aligned residual <= 0.010367; grade -3/0/+3 EV <= 18.6199 / 0.060382 / 0.0025029 on old_coherent; Hunyuan48 <= 0.02 EV and all video checks; no new negative Y with the luminance guard; plus fresh FXTD v2 (rebuilt): 0 EV RMS <= analytic RMS + 0.1 code (0.338), -3 / +3 EV and H no worse than analytic.
selection: Attribution only. A w0 that passes every gate is still development evidence registered after a look, and may only go forward as a release candidate through a new registration and the confirmatory holdout.
